## Core Specializations

1. **Front-End & Full-Stack Web Development**:
   - React, TypeScript, JavaScript (ESNext), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, HTML5, modern Web APIs.
   - Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare D1 (Serverless SQLite), Cloudflare R2, Durable Objects, WebSockets.
   - Offline-first architectures, real-time synchronization, edge caching, responsive micro-interactions.

2. **UI/UX & Digital Product Design**:
   - Figma, design systems, interactive prototypes, accessibility (WCAG AA), user journey mapping.
   - Conversion-focused SaaS layouts, dashboard interfaces, clean visual hierarchy.

3. **Embedded Systems & IoT Engineering**:
   - ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino, ARM Cortex, Raspberry Pi.
   - Hardware sensor integration (environmental, electrical, optical), MQTT, HTTP/REST, BLE, WiFi.
   - Circuit schematic design, PCB layout, low-power telemetry, custom firmware in C/C++.

4. **Digital Fabrication & Rapid Prototyping**:
   - FDM 3D printing (Snapmaker, Voron/CoreXY), CAD modeling (Fusion 360), slicing optimization.
   - Enclosure design, functional prototypes, production jigs, and custom hardware housings.

## Featured Production Projects

- [Arcion](https://arcion.in/): Modern CleanTech and IoT enterprise web platform designed with high-performance responsive UI, interactive telemetry, and dynamic product showcases.
- [BolKhata](https://bolkhata.harshgupta24716.workers.dev/): A lightning-fast, edge-native bilingual ledger and business accounting application deployed globally on Cloudflare Workers and D1 database.
- [Rewardlo](https://rewardlo-app.harshgupta24716.workers.dev/): Scalable customer loyalty and rewards engine featuring instant point redemption, automated merchant workflows, and edge database persistence.
- [SolarSaathi](https://harshugupta.in/projects): Clean energy monitoring platform combining IoT hardware sensor telemetry with real-time web dashboards for solar power optimization.
- [FestivAI](https://harshugupta.in/projects): AI-powered creative greeting and multimedia generation web application leveraging generative models and dynamic user customization.
- [ReviewLinks](https://harshugupta.in/projects): SaaS platform automating verified customer review generation and distribution across Google and social channels.
- [GitoPrompt](https://harshugupta.in/projects): Developer productivity tool streamlining multi-file codebase analysis and prompt engineering for Large Language Models.
- [ThreadScout](https://harshugupta.in/projects): Intelligent discussion discovery tool tracking relevant industry threads across Reddit, X, and community forums.
- [Custom Macropad & Hardware Prototypes](https://harshugupta.in/projects): Custom mechanical keyboard and productivity macropad featuring programmed hotkeys, QMK/custom firmware, and 3D printed mechanical enclosure.
